About Your Name Glass

Family-owned. Residential specialists. Serving Central Florida since 2008.

Why We Only Do Residential

When we started in 2008, we made a choice most glass companies don't: focus entirely on homeowners. No storefronts, no commercial contracts, no jobs where you're bidding against a dozen other companies to do work as cheap as possible.

Residential glass is different. Your home is where you live. The window we replace matters to you in a way that a storefront pane doesn't. We take that seriously — every measurement is done in person, every piece of glass is cut to exact fit, and we don't leave until it's right.

In 16 years, we've replaced thousands of windows, sliding doors, shower enclosures, and mirrors across Central Florida. Most of our work still comes from referrals and repeat customers — which tells us we're doing something right.
